latest_release.name: NanaZip 7.0, version 2610.2 (7.0.1882.0)
latest_release.body:
I'm excited to announce that we've released NanaZip 7.0, version 2610.2 (7.0.1882.0), now available for download.

Note: Read [NanaZip Technical Focus from Kenji Mouri](https://github.com/M2Team/NanaZip/issues/913) to clarify some future directions of NanaZip.

Starting with NanaZip 7.0, NanaZip follows a rolling release model. Read https://github.com/M2Team/NanaZip/blob/main/Documents/Versioning.md#release-tags for more information.

We recommend holding off on File Manager-related pull requests for now, as they may require a complete rewrite afterward. Such contributions may become practical again around mid-November or December.

## Release Notes

Note: These notes also cover the corresponding preview release.

- Synchronize 7-Zip mainline implementations to 26.05. (Except the NanaZip File Manager.) (Thanks to Igor Pavlov.)
- Synchronize the 7-Zip ZS implementations to https://github.com/mcmilk/7-Zip-zstd/tree/f7331b3fa14455d78a6e6a91bdd9571c999bb081. (Thanks to Sergey G. Brester and Tino Reichardt.)
- Synchronize Brotli implementations to v1.2.1. (https://github.com/google/brotli/releases/tag/v1.2.1)
- Synchronize RHash to the latest master (https://github.com/rhash/RHash/tree/0517ba2ed33de0afc2d999b3353287dce3b4611c) which is after v1.4.6.
